events.title: Rogue Traders – The Anthems 21st Anniversary Tour
events.description: Australian dance-rock band Rogue Traders, led by Natalie Bassingthwaighte, celebrate their 21st anniversary performing iconic 2000s anthems and new music in an explosive live show.

events.title: Queen Forever – Greatest Hits Tour
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A full-scale rock spectacle, Queen Forever celebrates 20 years of performing the legendary band's greatest hits with authenticity and energy, recreating Queen's power in their prime.

events.title: Music of the Night – Joey Fimmano
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: Joey Fimmano presents his sell-out show, a mesmerising stage production featuring timeless Andrew Lloyd Webber creations and other greatest musical hits from West End and Broadway.

events.title: The Poems, Prayers and Promises of John Denver – Darren Coggan
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: Award-winning performer Darren Coggan delivers a heartfelt tribute to John Denver, honouring his universal folk anthems with vocal authenticity in this musical journey.

events.title: You Am I at The Balcony – Coolangatta Hotel
events.description: Iconic Australian rock band You Am I perform live at The Balcony, a legendary beachfront venue, delivering their classic sound to the Gold Coast's southern end.

events.title: Baby Animals – Burleigh Town Hotel
events.description: Legendary Australian hard rock/alternative act Baby Animals perform their 90s hits and more in a powerful live show at the Burleigh Town Hotel.

events.title: Sunny Coast Rude Boys – Burleigh Town Hotel
events.description: The beloved ska/reggae/punk act, Sunny Coast Rude Boys, bring their energetic live show to Burleigh Town Hotel for a night of authentic subculture music.

events.title: Samsaruh – Voice Activation | Gold Coast
events.description: Australian artist Samsaruh presents an intimate and immersive "Voice Activation" live vocal performance, promising a unique artistic experience.

events.title: It's ON ChevrON – Street Party
events.description: A vibrant street party event transforming Thomas Drive on Chevron Island, celebrating the precinct's creative spirit with live music, food, and community activities.

events.title: Comedy Underground (with live music acts)
events.location: The Basement, The Star Gold Coast, Broadbeach
events.description: Based Comedy presents a weekly showcase of hand-picked stand-up talent and unique voices from Australia and beyond, frequently featuring live musical acts in an intimate basement setting.
